The evidence indicates a chain of targets, with Tradipitant acting as a modulator of the signaling cascade initiated by Pterosin C. The integration of these relationships highlights a possible role for Tradipitant in regulating thyrotropin receptor activity, though the exact nature of its interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The presence of a strong score in the pathway suggests a plausible but not yet fully understood connection between Tradipitant and the thyrotropin receptor.
